title: CROSSING BOUNDARIES: LEVERAGING SEMANTIC DIVERGENCES TO EXPLORE CULTURAL NOVELTY IN COOKING RECIPES

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring semantic divergences (e.g., Jensen-Shannon Divergence, Pointwise Mutual Information) in cooking recipe texts across different countries and correlating these novelty metrics with the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map.
Correlating textual novelty and divergence metrics in recipe adaptations with the physical geographical distances (in kilometers) between the capital cities of the respective countries.
Comparing textual divergence metrics in cultural recipe adaptations against linguistic distances between the closest major languages of different countries.
Evaluating the correlation between recipe text novelty metrics and the religious distance between the major religions practiced in pairs of countries.
